title: Sales invoices
description: Create a draft, submit it for independent approval, then post the approved invoice.
selectEntity: Select a legal entity to manage invoices.
serverTotals: Amounts below are calculated by the server using the invoice date and configured tax rules.
postConfirm: I have reviewed the approved invoice. Posting records it in the ledger; corrections require a credit note.
invalidDecimal: Enter a positive quantity and valid decimal amounts, with up to six decimal places. Discount must be between 0 and 100.
invalidDates: The due date must be on or after the issue date.
invalidVAT: A standard tax invoice requires a customer VAT number with 15 digits, starting and ending with 3.
lookupError: Could not load customers, products, units, or tax codes. Check your permissions and retry.
noOptions: Create an active customer, a sales product, a unit of measure, and an output tax code before creating an invoice.
error: The request failed. Please try again.
saved: Draft saved. Review the calculated invoice before submitting it for approval.
savedRounded: Draft saved. Some entered amounts were rounded; review the saved values before submitting.
submitConfirm: I have reviewed this invoice and want to submit it for independent approval.
waitingApproval: This invoice is awaiting an independent approver in the approval inbox.
makerOnly: Only the creator can submit this draft.
independentPost: A different user must post this approved invoice.
